notes:
An urgent fix for lasers with switches at the starting corner, like the Mecpow X3 Pro.

- **Jobs no longer end at the corner.** At the end of every job, frame and test square, the laser head now stops a little way in from the starting corner (5 mm), with the laser off. Going right back to the corner pressed the machine's end switches, which stopped it.
- **The next job can't get stuck at 0%.** Make it, Frame it and Test first only start when the machine says it is ready. If it isn't, AbsoDoodley says why in plain words and shows the button that fixes it: Unlock, Set corner, or Find its starting corner.
- **If the head touches an end switch,** the app now says: "The laser head touched an end switch at the edge of the machine. It is safe. Move the head away from the edge, then set the starting corner again."
- **The arrows and Set corner are always there** in the Machine panel when the machine is ready, even if AbsoDoodley couldn't read the machine's settings. The steps now say: "Move the laser head to the front left corner, then move it a little away from the edges (about 1/4 inch), and press Set corner."
- When the machine's settings can't be read, the Machine panel says so, and which defaults it is using.
- **Report a problem and the support file** now include everything the app and the machine said to each other while connecting, and the end of the latest job, to help find the cause.
